role: C04 ten individual production TypeScript documentation reviews
method: Read all complete original hunks and authenticated raw commit/before/after Git blobs. Independently reason about each documentation change. Compare every noncomment syntax/type token, all JSDoc tags and compiler/bundler/test annotations in all32 whole programs. No installed-runtime or broad docs-label inference.

reviews.subject: docs(material/list): fix grammar in MAT_LIST_CONFIG token description (#28284)
reviews.decision: Only the MAT_LIST_CONFIG description adds the missing word “for”. The complete token declaration, import, options interface and all executable/type syntax are unchanged. This is documentation grammar, not a token-identity or default-options fix to adopt.

reviews.subject: docs(multiple): Update color input comments to standarize across the components (#29254)
reviews.decision: All thirteen modern component files change color-input prose or its M3 guide link; their complete code, signatures and policy tags are unchanged. These descriptions do not authorize narrowing the owned historical color/M2 palette contract or requiring consumer Sass/CSS changes. Native M3 theming of legacy controls remains outside the first-stable requirement.

reviews.subject: docs(material/datepicker): Added context to docs for date picker null value #29385 (#29387)
reviews.decision: The date-filter documentation explains an already nullable date argument and the absence of selection. The complete DateFilterFn type and implementation-bearing file are unchanged. No new null-handling behavior or consumer TypeScript fix follows from this documentation patch; actual datepicker runtime qualification remains separate.

reviews.subject: docs: fix whether typos
reviews.decision: Four component comments correct “Wheter” to “Whether”. The hideSingleSelectionIndicator declarations and all complete option/select/list/selectable-list code remain identical. This neither adds the modern input to the owned frozen API nor changes selection, icon visibility or styling.

reviews.subject: docs(material/dialog): remove default value from doc string (#31025)
reviews.decision: Both CDK and Material dialog configuration comments remove the stated80vw default; neither complete configuration program changes. The filtered inventory omitted the CDK file, now included in this review. The owned MatLegacyDialogConfig explicitly retains override maxWidth =80vw, bound to its actual source hash. This prose removal is not permission to remove the historical default. Packed/default-width behavior remains a separate product gate.

reviews.subject: docs(multiple): remove invalid tags from doc strings (#31317)
reviews.decision: All seven complete TypeScript files only replace invalid inline link markup with code formatting or clarify the fixed-layout identifier in prose. The full patch includes Google Maps marker-clusterer types omitted by the filtered inventory. Every existing JSDoc tag, including docs-private on the view-repeater token, remains identical; no private API becomes public and no local-helper ownership restriction is relaxed.

reviews.subject: docs(material/datepicker): fix typo in aria-accessible-name comment (#32703)
reviews.decision: The datepicker input-element helper comment corrects “funciton” to “function”; complete SSR checks, node-name predicate, signatures and metadata are unchanged. Main previously labeled this typo inherited without behavior proof. It is a documentation-only patch, not an inherited runtime repair or SSR compatibility qualification.

reviews.subject: docs(material/datepicker): fixed typo in ssrSafeIsHTMLTextAreaElement function description (#33107)
reviews.decision: The textarea helper description corrects the same spelling error. Complete source tokens, signatures, JSDoc tags and build annotations are unchanged. This does not change or certify SSR safety, browser element identity or the current public datepicker behavior; those remain separately accountable.

reviews.subject: docs(material/bottom-sheet): update panelClass comment (#33321)
reviews.decision: Only the ordinary bottom-sheet panelClass description changes from container to overlay panel. Neither complete configuration syntax nor any class-placement implementation changes. This does not authorize a component fork, a relocated legacy class or consumer CSS changes; actual current companion overlay behavior remains separate.

limitations: These ten documentation-only subjects are the finite scope, not all docs-labeled commits or the whole upstream inventory. Sass/body/API/test/demo changes remain outside it.
Original source observations do not execute installed peers, constructors, components, browser/SSR/Sass, packed artifacts or complete consumer floors.
No product or consumer API/HTML/CSS/SCSS is changed; inherited behavior, security review and all other G11 obligations remain separate.
